## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. For hardware changes, identify
the tested model, board, kernel and relevant userspace versions. State anything
not verified.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] This contribution targets `main` and follows [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/andreinita21/OmarchyM4Mini/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] PR text and commit metadata credit human contributors only and follow the attribution policy.
- [ ] Existing upstream attribution and license notices are preserved.
- [ ] Evidence is concise and contains no credentials or personal machine data.

Only changes verified on the mini are merged; experiments belong in the private alpha.
